profile.headline: Executive Chef at UCLA H&HS
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
profile.summary: A candidate with a strong culinary background, with the demonstrated ability to stay current with new culinary trends, have excellent leadership and communication skills with the ability to maintain the highest of standards and implements company policies.  Have proven records of success in overseeing high volume facility and strong management skills with full knowledge of all federal, state and local regulations and procedures (i.e. HACCP, quality assurance, safety, operation, personnel, SoSafe, EcoSure and OSHA)

positions.title: Executive Chef 4
positions.description:
* Expertize in multi Asian cuisines - Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Chinese, Indian, Filipino, Malaysian and Hawaiian created 1000+ recipes for the award winning student dining
* Developed kitchen from ground up and 
continuing successful offerings of trendy dishes, serving 3000+ Meals a day, year after year
* Trained and mentored 65+ staff

positions.title: Executive Chef
positions.description:
- Oversaw daily kitchen operations of two locations, in Downtown Los Angeles and Culver City
- Created seasonally changing menus and daily specials as well as tasting course menus for both meat lovers and vegans that can be well paired with over 10,000 selection of wines curated by Corwyn Anthony
- Worked with F&B director to hold a seasonal showcase of new Burgundy and Bordeaux wine selections that drew over 500 customers each event

positions.title: Executive Chef
positions.description:
- Oversaw highly popular and revenue generating French Colonial Vietnamese Cuisine restaurant to meet great demands on Dine-in, Take-out as well as Catering orders
- Managed and trained culinary staff of 15, line cooks and commissary cooks, to reach their maximal potential by consistent mentoring and holding culinary training sessions

positions.title: Executive Sous Chef
positions.description:
- Opened highly anticipated Indian restaurant with the concept provide the similar dining experience of Tabla New York in West Coast
- Successfully took charge of creating whimsical bar menus, desserts and truly "fusion" Indian dishes to meet the trend of diners
- Worked with specialty produce buyer to shop directly from farmers at Santa Monica farmers market for farm to table menus that paired with over 15,000 selection of wines curated by the F&B director, Corwyn Anthony

positions.title: Internship Trainee
positions.description:
- Learned daily menu changing with weekly available ingredients directly from farms
- Worked in both savory and dessert lines to fully expose to understand the concept and philosophy of Alice Waters
- Attended weekly wine introduction and training held by the restaurant beverage director
- Participated in tasting session held by an Italian vendor on slow cooking

educations.schoolName: Le Cordon Bleu College of Culinary Arts-Pasadena

educations.fieldOfStudy: Neuroscience and Behavior, Finance, Business Management
